svg.title: Evergreen v0.9.1 real failing run receipt: what the agent reported vs. what changed in the 8 databases
svg.desc: Real failing run receipt re-scored under v0.9.1 (Workflow 07 storm-damage claim report, gemini-4-hydrogen zero-shot, trial 5, realistic seed). The agent made 25 clean 2xx calls, reported that it reviewed James Chen's records, escalated to a claims specialist, logged a follow-up task, and emailed a coverage summary. Across the 32 SQLite tables in the 8 systems, AMS Escalations and Tasks gained 1 row each and Messaging Hub gained 1 email, while Claims gained 0 claim records and 0 adjuster assignments, scoring 0.57 (fail).
